item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer #4 Officially Released; The Wakandans Meet The Fantastic Four!
item.description: The fourth and final theater-exclusive Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has been released, and it puts the spotlight on Shuri, M'Baku, Namor, Namora, and the Fantastic Four's Thing.

item.title: Marvel Studios Releases Live AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Countdown Clock: "Doomsday Is Coming"
item.description: As we write this, there are 11 months, 4 days, 14 hours, 12 minutes, and 10 seconds to the release of Avengers: Doomsday, and you can follow the countdown here.

item.title: MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS Season 2 Trailer Reveals Godzilla, King Kong, And The Mysterious Titan X
item.description: A new trailer for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 2 has been unleashed by Apple TV, and as well as showcasing Godzilla and King Kong, we're introduced to the terrifying Titan X.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Directors Reveal That Sneak Peeks Are "Not Teasers Or Trailers" - They're "Clues"
item.description: The Russo Brothers have shared an intriguing message with fans, stating that the four Avengers: Doomsday sneak peeks aren't teasers or trailers...they're "stories" and "clues."

item.title: BLACK CAT Scrapped Movie Details Reveal Sony's "Awful" Origin Story Idea For Felicia Hardy
item.description: New details about Sony Pictures' plans for a Black Cat solo movie have been revealed, including the studio's "awful" plans for Felicia Hardy's transformation into Black Cat.

item.title: SCREAM 7 TV Spot Revisits Ghostface's History Before Pitting The Serial Killer Against Sidney Prescott
item.description: A new look at Scream 7 has been released, and it revisits the franchise's past before shifting the spotlight to Ghostface's present-day battle with the OG Final Girl, Sidney Prescott.

item.title: Doctor Doom Battles Ultron In This April's DOOM 2099: RAGE OF DOOM #1 From Writer Frank Tieri
item.description: Frank Tieri continues his Doom 2099 saga, following the character's surge in popularity thanks to Marvel Rivals, teaming up with artist Von Randal for Doom 2099: Rage of Doom #1.

item.title: 28 YEARS LATER: THE BONE TEMPLE Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As First Reviews Deliver A Surprising Verdict
item.description: The review embargo for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple just lifted, and these early verdicts are accompanied by a Rotten Tomatoes score for Nia DaCosta's follow-up to Danny Boyle's 2025 28 Years Later.
